In a scale-free network, bridge agents connect dense clusters and are pivotal for information flow without being as exposed to backlash as hubs. Targeting them with morally framed messages (e.g., fairness, shared responsibility) promotes prosocial norms while respecting autonomy by appealing to internal values. This approach leverages moral motivation to build durable cooperation, minimizing polarization by avoiding economic or identity-based divisions.
